title: TNF-NF-κB-p53 axis restricts in vivo survival of hPSC-derived dopamine neurons
model: H9 hPSC-derived dopamine neurons, Dox-inducible Cas9, 538-guide cell-death/survival library
contrast: Grafted (in vivo) vs in vitro edited pool, day 25 (1 vs 1; technical re-reads summed)
paper_method: Enrichment of guides in graft vs in vitro (focused survival screen)
paper_calls: TP53-mediated apoptosis and TNF-NF-κB signalling limit graft survival; TP53, BBC3 validated
barcs_calls: 1 gene at FDR 0.10 (TP53, enriched); 3 against the control null; controls-calibrated
named_hits: TP53 #1 of 164 (FDR ~0, empirical 0.003); BBC3, BAX, CASP9 enriched in direction but not significant
verdict: BARCS recovers the paper's central hit, TP53, as the single clear gene whose knockout rescues grafted neurons; the downstream apoptosis and TNF-NF-κB genes trend the same way but are not individually significant with one library per condition.
